lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: geometry and measurement

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

steps: Define the relevant quantities and assumptions.
State a conclusion with its limitation or evidence.
workedSolution.answer: show calculations and compare predictions to data

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: Which conclusion communicates a mathematical model responsibly?
choices: State the result, units, assumption, and limitation.
Claim the model is always correct.
Hide the assumption and data source.

items.prompt: A moving company charges by the number of hours worked. Which definition of x best models this situation?
A service is modeled by C = 12h + 25, where h is hours. Which assumption supports this model?
choices: Every service has the same total cost.
The number of hours is always zero.
The flat fee changes each hour.
The hourly charge remains $12 for every hour.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A savings balance increases by $15 each week. Which model type is appropriate?
A model gives 8x - 2 = 22. What is x?
Two constraints are y = 1x + 5 and y = 6x - 45. What is their shared solution?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt: A rectangular design has side lengths 3 units and 4 units. What is its diagonal?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In a data set, hours practiced increase and performance scores generally increase. What association is shown?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
